glosses: a lightweight container, generally round, open at the top, and tapering toward the bottom
a circular hoop, from which a net is suspended, which is the goal through which the players try to throw the ball

examples.text: O gato está na sua cesta.
examples.en: The cat is in its basket.

examples.text: A minha cesta está debaixo da mesa.
examples.en: My basket is under the table.

examples.text: Um gato acabou de sair da cesta.
examples.en: A cat just came out of the basket.

examples.text: Tom pôs a cesta sobre a mesa.
examples.en: Tom set the basket on the table.
